message.content:
Turbonomic can help Unilever leverage AI for multi‑cloud observability by providing a unified, real‑time view of workloads, resources, and performance across all public clouds (GCP, AWS, Azure) and private environments. It uses AI/ML to automatically detect anomalies, predict capacity needs, and recommend optimizations that keep applications running smoothly while controlling costs.

Key differences compared to native cloud observability tools:

| Feature | Turbonomic | Native Cloud Observability |
|--------|------------|---------------------------|
| **Unified view** | One pane for all clouds + on‑prem | Separate dashboards per provider |
| **AI‑driven insights** | Predictive analytics, anomaly detection, automated recommendations | Mostly reactive alerts or manual analysis |
| **Cost optimization** | Real‑time cost modeling & automated actions | Cost dashboards + manual budgeting |
| **Automation** | Policy‑based automation (scale, move, terminate) | Limited automation; often requires scripting |
| **Vendor lock‑in** | Independent of provider APIs | Tied to each provider’s ecosystem |

In short, Turbonomic extends native observability by adding AI‑powered decision support and cross‑cloud automation that native tools alone don’t provide.
